# Dogs: loglinear model for binary data
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_1.dogs
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model {
    for (i in 1 : Dogs) {
        xa[i, 1] <- 0
        xs[i, 1] <- 0 
        p[i, 1] <- 0
    
        for (j in 2 : Trials) {
            xa[i, j] <- sum(Y[i, 1 : j - 1])
            xs[i, j] <- j - 1 - xa[i, j]
            log(p[i, j]) <- alpha * xa[i, j] + beta * xs[i, j]
            y[i, j] <- 1 - Y[i, j]
            y[i, j] ~ dbern(p[i, j])
        }
    }
    alpha ~ dunif(-10, -0.00001)
    beta ~ dunif(-10, -0.00001)
    A <- exp(alpha)
    B <- exp(beta)
}
""", false)

build_model(data) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data)
